Sea Areas Around the island
A low-pressure area formed over the central parts of south Bay of Bengal to the south east of Sri Lanka.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins issued
by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota
to Trincomalee via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the other sea
areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
